sections.title: Hotfix Bug Fix Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix for bugs recently discovered. Replay codes from the February 18, 2025 patch are still available.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed a bug with Perks not being granted at the start of round 3 on Payload and Hybrid Maps.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Ashe Fixed a bug with Viper's Sting failing to properly refresh its count when hitting new targets. Doomfist Fixed a bug with Block not granting Doomfist charge for Blocking some abilities. Illari Fixed a bug with Illari's Solar Power Perk occasionally locking out Illari from using Solar Rifle's Healing Beam. Pharah Fixed a bug with Helix Shield not correctly applying if the Perk is selected while you are dead. Venture Fixed a bug with the Covered in Dirt Perk erroneously affecting Drill Dash.
